notes.title: Are you tough enough?
notes.notes: Are you tough enough to beat the Ascendrix' hardcore mode? So prove it! Beat the hardcore mode and show your best in this ascent nigtmare.

notes.title: The first DLC is in development
notes.notes: Ascendrix's first DLC is in progress. It will contain a new map with more traps and several paths. The name of DLC and the date of release will be announced soon.
